title: EQR weights: static fit vs yearly expanding refit (point-in-time)

variants.STATIC: weights fitted once on data up to the fit end (current)
variants.EXP: each January 1, weights (1/sd, positive Sharpe) fitted on all data from 2010-06 to the previous Dec 31 (first fit at 2013-01 with 2010-06..2012-12)

selection: book Sharpe 2018-22 with STATIC fitted on 2010-17 vs EXP (point-in-time)
judgement: chosen variant; ONE evaluation 2023-26 vs 1.231 (STATIC fitted 2010-22); adopt only if EXP and higher
